instruction: Please flip this video to the correct orientation and save it as '1984_Apple_Macintosh_Commercial.mp4' on the Desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Variation 0: Check if the rotated video file exists at the correct location on Desktop. This verifies the agent successfully saved the file with the correct name after rotation.

llm_judge_reasons: CRITICAL: Evaluator only checks file existence, not video rotation/orientation - the PRIMARY requirement
Incomplete verification: Does not verify the video was actually flipped/rotated to correct orientation
No content validation: File existence test cannot distinguish between correctly rotated video vs empty file, unprocessed copy, or simple rename
Missing core requirement coverage: Instruction explicitly requires 'flip this video to the correct orientation' but evaluator provides no mechanism to verify this transformation occurred
False positives possible: Task would pass by simply creating/renaming any file at the target path without any video processing
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add getter to extract video rotation metadata (e.g., using ffprobe to read rotation tag or display matrix)
Add metric to compare video orientation/rotation angle (expect 180° or 0° rotation depending on source orientation)
Alternative: Add getter to compare file checksum/size with source file to ensure content was modified
Alternative: Add getter to extract video frame dimensions/aspect ratio to verify transformation occurred
Consider adding validation that output file is a valid MP4 video (not just any file with .mp4 extension)
